title: DataReplica
summary: DataReplica is an AI-powered web tool with a FastAPI backend that lets users upload CSV datasets and generate privacy-safe synthetic data with configurable rows, column types, and quality/privacy reports. It runs SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, CTGANSynthesizer, and TVAESynthesizer for tabular generation and SDMetrics' DCRBaselineProtection for the privacy score.
evidence: backend/utils/synthetic.py:125-131 instantiates CTGANSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer, GaussianCopulaSynthesizer; privacy_score.py uses sdmetrics DCRBaselineProtection
